from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A parsed instance of one provided document, capturing its title and outgoing references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper, as found in the document")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers explicitly cited in this document's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
